explication: This repository is a community-maintained collection of independent ServiceNow code snippets, not a single application or importable package. The principal workflow is for a developer to browse a category, select and adapt a snippet, then use it in a ServiceNow instance. The six category branches reflect the README and file tree; snippets within them are alternatives, not stages in a shared runtime. Relationships are documented only at this repository-wide level, so the graph does not infer calls between unsampled examples.
